note: Town art manifest. Props are RGBA PNGs keyed out of AI-generated sheets (tools/town/cut.py); any file can be replaced by dropping a PNG with the same name into public/town/props/. Ground JPGs in public/town/ground/ come from tools/town/ground.py. Missing files are skipped; if the base cobble or <9 props are missing the game falls back to the old procedural town. Placement/sizes live in src/level.ts buildTown() (Decor.sw is the on-screen width in tiles-widths).
